versions.subject: rule: renamed powershell
versions.detection:
selection:
    Description: 'Windows PowerShell'
    Company: 'Microsoft Corporation'
filter:
    Image: '*\powershell.exe'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Description="Windows PowerShell" Company="Microsoft Corporation" NOT Image="*\\powershell.exe"
